contract.dispatch: D(n) sets ii=0, ig=n, ih=true. ad() evaluates av[ig][ii] condition to trigger C(aw[ig][ii]).
contract.tick_model: C(n) initializes gc=0, fW=n, fX=0, fV=true. Each frame V() executes: if (++gc >= aB[fW][fX]), gc = aB[fW][fX], executes opcode az[fW][fX], and advances ++fX.
contract.milestone_definition: aB values are cumulative tick milestones since sequence start, NOT individual step durations.
contract.text_waiting: When action 4 (dialogue) runs, gd=true and sequence pauses until user presses Key 5.
